standard-dialogue-before-the-player-has-.speaker: Nomad
standard-dialogue-before-the-player-has-.text: Hey! Talk to me if you want to know anything worth knowing.

standard-dialogue-before-the-player-has-.npc: Best talk to his highness over there, 'fore he goes gettin' upset.

options.text: What exactly is the Soul Obelisk?

steps.player: What exactly is the Soul Obelisk?

steps.npc: It's 'ard to say. Me master never told what it is or why he built it.

steps.player: Wait a second... He built it?

steps.npc: I saw 'im build it with me own eyes. I were the one who 'ad to carry his materials to this island!

options.text: So what is Nomad really up to?

steps.player: So what is Nomad really up to?

steps.npc: Well, me master is as secretive as they come. Af'er all my time here, I still know next to nuffin' about him.
He's been up to summat since I've been here, but 'e had to have been an adventurer at some point. He has a massive stockpile of loot.

steps.player: He seems to know his way around some strange creatures too.

steps.npc: He does. He doesn't seem to care about that sorta stuff no more though. Since I've known 'im, he's only been obsessin' over gettin' as many people to play his game as possible.
Lost if I know. Like I said, 'e's as secretive as they come.

options.text: Tell me how you got to be here.

steps.player: Tell me how you got to be here.

steps.npc: I don't really know. I just woke up one day and 'ad to obey me master's commands.
Aye. All I can remember before that is a glowing box and sumfin' to do with beads.

steps.player: It sounds like Nomad is quite the hunter.

steps.text: If the player is under level 71 Hunter:

steps.player: I read somewhere that skilled hunters can capture imps.

steps.npc: That's sad to hear. It's just so 'ard to ignore shiny beads when I see 'em.

options.text: I'm quite the hunter myself, and some hunters like to capture imps.

steps.player: I'm quite the hunter myself, and some hunters like to capture imps.

steps.npc: Really? They abuse our love of beads just to test their skills?

steps.player: No need to worry, I'll give you no hassle. I'm only here to chat.

options.text: I'm quite the hunter myself, and I love capturing imps.

steps.player: I'm quite the hunter myself, and I love capturing imps.
Only joking! I couldn't resist. Now, where were we?

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-attempt.text: You've got no reason to bother that poor imp.

soul-wars-demonstration-dialogue-near-th.npc: I can't really chit-chat with me Master 'round. Go see what he wants.
